evidence.detail: respond_to_card_names now wraps trigger_typing() in try/except Forbidden: return — bot silently exits if it cannot post in the channel, preventing the Forbidden crashes

Bot now uses interactions.py (not the old discord.py from the 2018 stack traces); the entire code path in the original stack traces (bot.py:48 on_message, command.py:880 send_image_with_retry with aiohttp payload bug) no longer exists
bakert's final comment: 'None of these are reproducible. They may just be temporary network conditions/the price of doing business. Backlogging this rather than closing it.'

triage.notes: Confidence is medium rather than high because there is no single fixing commit to cite — the fix came from a full library migration (discord.py → interactions.py) and incremental hardening. A narrow residual gap exists: if trigger_typing() succeeds but send() raises Forbidden (different permission sets), no user-facing error is shown; however this is an edge case the framework handles silently.
